thread:
Ava Kim: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — task-runner paging still noisy across regions. Dropping owners + minimal plan here so we can close out RDW-4501.

Ava Kim: Proposal summary: dedupe by task_id + error_fingerprint + region; increase `for` window to 3m to avoid 1s spikes; add suppression predicate for transient db/cache errors; add `paged_until` annotation (start with 90m).

Diego Ramos: Current prod alert for reference:
```yaml
alert: TaskRunnerFailures
expr: increase(sum(rate(task_errors[1m])) by (task), 5) > 7
for: 30s
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/pm-2026-03-15
```

Lina Zhou: `for: 30s` explains the noise. I'll own telemetry: emit `pages_per_fingerprint` and `inter_page_seconds` so we can tune `paged_until` empirically. Target: Wed.

Marcus Chen: I'll open the alert PR to infra/alerts/taskrunner.yml and stage a 48h canary in `canary-taskrunner` ns. PR will include `rollback_plan` and a `test_vector` script. Target: PR by Mon EOD.

oncall-bot: Reminder: alert PRs must include rollback_plan and test_vector per policy.

Priya Rao: Important: do NOT dedupe across regions blindly. Use group_by: [task, error_fingerprint, region] so a regional outage still surfaces.

Diego Ramos: Suggest suppression predicate: if increase(task_errors{transient="true"}[10m]) / increase(task_errors[10m]) >= 0.8 then suppress pages for that fingerprint.

Marcus Chen: Agree, will add `paged_until` annotation with default 90m and `backoff: exponential(2m,2,5)` for re-notify. PR draft will show these examples.

Lina Zhou: I'll add a Grafana panel (pages per fingerprint heatmap) and attach to the PR for reviewers.

Ava Kim: Action items (RDW-4501):
- Marcus Chen: PR & rollout plan (infra/alerts/taskrunner.yml) — target Mon EOD
- Lina Zhou: Telemetry + Grafana panels — target Wed
- Diego Ramos: Canary validation script + 24/72h snapshots — after canary
- Priya Rao: Runbook edits (how to check/silence/escalate) — target Tue

Priya Rao: I'll assign owners on the Jira ticket and will follow up in 7 days. Owners, please update RDW-4501 within 7 days or set a new ETA.

Marcus Chen: PR opened (draft): https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/821 — includes rollback.sh and scripts/alert_smoke.sh. Not merging until canary shows duplicate-page reduction.

Diego Ramos: Kicked off canary now. Will post 24h and 72h aggregated counts + unique fingerprints into RDW-4501.

Priya Rao: Also add a safety bypass: any alert with `priority=critical` bypasses suppression for initial 5m so ops sees it.

Ava Kim: Sounds good. Reconvene in 7 days to close action items. Ping @Ava Kim here if you need extensions. :thumbsup:
